Question: How many orders did we sell in Sao Paulo?
text:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_in_sao_paulo
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN sellers AS s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
WHERE s.seller_city = 'Sao Paulo';

-- This counts the distinct orders that include at least one item sold by a seller whose city is São Paulo.
